candidates.name: @electric-sql/pglite/worker (PGliteWorker)
candidates.fit_for_gap: G1/G8: move WASM Postgres off the main thread; single leader across tabs for idb://uar-threads

evidence.claim: Worker per tab, leader election, only the leader runs init; onLeaderChange/isLeader exposed
Plugin extensions such as live are exposed on the main thread via the PGliteWorker extensions option; PGliteWorker.create gives typed pg.live
frontend/node_modules/@electric-sql/pglite/dist/worker/index.d.ts declares PGliteWorker, worker({init}), LeaderChangedError in the installed version

risks: Seed load (client.ts:113-117) and runMigrations must move into the worker init, or the stale-seed defect moves with it
Run-snapshot live subscriptions must be re-verified through the worker at the boundary
Leader change mid-write: LeaderChangedError must be handled by callers
candidates.decision_rationale: Removes the multi-tab IndexedDB hazard and main-thread WASM cost with an upstream-supported API; adaptation is the init/seed move.

candidates.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core 5.0.1 startLocalFirstGraph (incumbent)
candidates.fit_for_gap: G1/G8: bounded snapshot persistence during streaming

evidence.claim: dist/index.d.ts StartLocalFirstGraphOptions exposes persistDebounceMs only (default 50); no max-wait or type filter
